explanation: Faithfully encodes the literal question on erdosproblems.com/1193 ('is the lower density of {n : 1_A∗1_A(n) = g(n)} always 0?', for monotone positive g) and its trivial negative answer. A = ℕ with g(n) = n + 1 gives the whole of ℕ. The docstring transparently notes that Erdős presumably intended extra restrictions, which are not recorded.
